title: 第615章 混战第614章 喜提后半部紫阳神功
slug: 道爷斗法累了西幻炸个鱼怎么了
lines: “不对啊！不对啊！”
一位老者模样的化神修士快速掐着手诀，额头不断冒出豆大的汗珠。
“神算子，你不是说这回行动万无一失的吗？！这家伙怎么会这么强？！”
“不可能，我的推算不可能出错啊！”
被称为神算子的化神修士哭着脸说道。
“按照我先前的推算，面对诸多化神修士的包围，这渊剑宗的小鬼应当在绝望中力竭而亡啊！！！”
“废话太多了，紫阳崩星剑！！！”
陈昭甩出一把闪着电光的紫色长剑，空中顿时炸出一个紫色火球，旋即有数个焦黑的人形从空中跌落。
三十三，算上后续支援赶来的，正面战场的化神修士，共有三十三人。
一位元婴可一人灭国，一位化神可令一方大陆震动。
而如今数十位化神齐聚此处，足以令天空改换颜色，使大地崩碎成粉末。
可见幕后之人为了将渊剑宗斩草除根，不惜派出远超常规的力量。
就算渊剑宗的合体老祖复活过来，面对这般多的化神强者，也得暂避锋芒，远遁逃离。
更别说，陈昭只是个小小的元婴后期修士了，既然已经将宗内其他人送走，直接原地tp去机甲界躲着才是最合理的选择。
但，这是废物的思维。
“力量的不足并不可怕，战斗意志的丧失，才真的危险。所以我要在这里，将你们这三十三位化神，全部杀掉！！！”
【你力量哪里不足了……】
说话间，陈昭的身影如鬼魅般消失，化为一道紫色流光，
“他去哪了？！”
“跟着那道流光走！冲你去了！”
“来的好，看我神枪无敌……”
咚咚咚！！！
显形的瞬间，陈昭手中帝龙枪高速刺出数百记，在瞬间突破这位化神修士的护体灵力。
“坠云。”
没和这位使枪修士过多纠缠，陈昭直接释放光炮，粗大的光柱自帝龙枪尖端放出，瞬间抹除了使枪修士半边身子。
将这化神修士的尸体丢入万魂幡，陈昭一脚踏在空中，顿时掀起一阵轰隆音爆，整个人如炮弹般冲向下一个化神修士。
“呵，不过是些小伎俩，法天象地，起！！！”
被盯上的修士当机立断，双手一拍，身形快速膨胀起来，很快便化作一尊高约百丈的巨象法相。
“动物法相？倒是罕见，紫阳霸天龙，去！”
陈昭口令一动，便有数不尽的浓郁紫气从身体中涌出，在空中构成一头近百米高的壮硕巨龙。
霸天龙目光凶戾，张口便是一击龙吼，巨大的声波镇的那巨象猛的一颤，两扇耳朵刚要耷拉下去，便看到霸天龙一个猛扑冲上前。
撕啦！！
content_en:
"It's wrong! It's wrong!"
An old-looking god-transforming monk quickly performed hand gestures, with large beads of sweat appearing on his forehead.
"Fortunate God, didn't you say that this move was foolproof?! How could this guy be so strong?!"
"Impossible, my calculation cannot be wrong!"
The god-transforming monk, known as the divine fortune teller, said with a tearful face.
"According to my previous calculations, faced with being surrounded by many god-forming monks, this brat from the Yuanjian Sect should have died of exhaustion in despair!!!"
"Too much nonsense, Ziyang Collapse Star Sword!!!"
Boom! ! !
Chen Zhao threw out a purple sword that flashed with lightning, and a purple fireball exploded in the air. Immediately, several charred human figures fell from the air.
Thirty-three, including the follow-up support arriving, there are a total of thirty-three monks on the front battlefield.
A Yuanying can destroy a country by himself, and a transformed god can shake a continent.
But now dozens of transformed gods gathered here, enough to change the color of the sky and make the earth crumble into powder.
It can be seen that the people behind the scenes did not hesitate to send forces that far exceeded the norm in order to eradicate the Yuanjian Sect.
Even if the combined ancestor of the Yuanjian Sect is resurrected, facing so many powerful gods, he will have to temporarily avoid the sharp edge and escape far away.
Not to mention, Chen Zhao is just a small late-stage Nascent Soul cultivator. Since he has sent away the rest of the sect, it is the most reasonable choice to just go and hide in the mecha world.
But this is rubbish thinking.
"The lack of strength is not terrible, but the loss of the will to fight is really dangerous. So I am going to kill all thirty-three of you here!!!"
[Where is your strength lacking...]
As he spoke, Chen Zhao's figure disappeared like a ghost, turning into a stream of purple light.
"Where has he gone?!"
"Follow that stream of light! It's coming towards you!"
"Well done, look at my invincibility..."
Boom, boom, boom! ! !
The moment he revealed himself, the Emperor Dragon Spear in Chen Zhao's hand stabbed hundreds of times at high speed, instantly breaking through the body-protecting spiritual power of the god-transformation monk.
"Falling clouds."
Without getting too entangled with the spear-wielding monk, Chen Zhao directly released the light cannon, and a thick beam of light was released from the tip of the Emperor Dragon Spear, instantly wiping out half of the spear-wielding monk's body.
Throwing the body of the god-transformation monk into the Ten Thousand Souls Banner, Chen Zhao stepped on the air, immediately setting off a booming sonic boom, and rushed towards the next god-transformation monk like a cannonball.
"Oh, it's just a little trick, the law of heaven and earth, rise!!!"
The targeted monk made an immediate decision, clapped his hands, and his body quickly expanded, and soon turned into a giant elephant about a hundred feet tall.
"Animal Dharma? It's rare. Purple Yang Tyrant Dragon, go!"
As soon as Chen Zhao commanded, countless rich purple energy surged out of his body, forming a giant dragon nearly a hundred meters high in the air.
The Tyrant Dragon's eyes were ferocious, and he opened his mouth and let out a dragon roar. The huge sound wave made the giant elephant tremble violently. Just as his ears were about to droop down, he saw Tyrannosaurus swooping forward.
Tear it apart! !
